inputs.text: [excited] Meh… gah… THEER… ee… um. In Greek, "mega" means giant, huge. [proud] And "therium" means beast. The giant beast.
[happily] Nope, not a dinosaur — [serious] it showed up way later, in the Ice Age, [pauses] a million years ago. It was a giant sloth, in South America.
[confident] The biggest sloth that ever lived — [amazed] as big as an elephant, not like the one sleeping in a tree.
